title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jd:
About the Company B-Tech is a remote-first technology company that partners with enterprise clients to deliver tailored software solutions solving complex, real-world operational problems. With a lean, highly skilled engineering team distributed across multiple locations, B-Tech emphasises autonomy, rapid iteration, and close collaboration with customers to ensure every deployment delivers measurable value.
About the Role B-Tech is seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer with around 4 years of experience to join our fully remote team. In this role, you will work closely with clients to understand their unique challenges, then design, build, and deploy custom solutions that integrate seamlessly into their existing workflows. You will act as both an engineer and a trusted technical partner, balancing hands-on development with direct client interaction.
Key Responsibilities Engage directly with client stakeholders remotely to gather requirements and understand pain points. Design and build custom integrations, tools, and features tailored to individual client needs. Rapidly prototype solutions and iterate based on client feedback. Provide ongoing technical support and troubleshooting for deployed solutions. Collaborate with internal engineering and product teams to relay client insights and inform the product roadmap. Document solutions and maintain clear communication throughout the deployment lifecycle.
Requirements Approximately 4 years of experience in software engineering, solutions engineering, or a similar client-facing technical role. Strong full stack development skills with proficiency in modern programming languages and frameworks. Experience deploying and supporting software solutions in production client environments. Excellent problem-solving abilities and comfort working with ambiguous or evolving requirements. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build trust with clients remotely. Self-motivated and comfortable working independently in a distributed team.
Benefits Salary of 75,000 to 80,000 GBP, dependent on experience. Fully remote working with flexible hours. Home office setup allowance. Generous paid time off. Health and wellness benefits. Opportunities for professional development and career growth. A collaborative, autonomous team culture focused on delivering real client impact.
